title: Exact Tail Laws for Nonlinear SGD with Infinite-Variance Gradients
abstract: arXiv:2610.23750v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: With infinite-variance gradient noise, SGD can have infinite expected excess objective even when most iterates are close to the optimum. We characterize its accuracy through exact first-order tail probabilities for the last iterate of nonlinear, constant-stepsize SGD. For regularly varying innovations of index $t\in(1,2)$, the leading measure transports one large gradient shock through the local Hessian flow. This is the same measure that governs the central stable Ornstein--Uhlenbeck limit; we prove its relative accuracy at shrinking tolerances above the central scale, with state-dependent noise and a growing observation horizon. The admissible window is nonempty for every available gradient moment $p>1$. The main technical step is a moment bound at the central fluctuation scale and a lower-moment control of the nonlinear error. The result yields explicit projection and excess-objective tails, extreme quantiles, and a factor $b^{1-t}$

translated_title: 具有无限方差梯度的非线性随机梯度下降（SGD）的精确尾部律
translated_abstract: 当梯度噪声具有无限方差时，即使大多数迭代点已非常接近最优解，SGD 的期望超额目标仍可能为无穷。我们通过非线性、恒定步长 SGD 最后一次迭代的精确一阶尾部概率来刻画其精度。对于指数为 $t\in(1,2)$ 的正则变化新息，主导测度将单个大的梯度冲击沿局部 Hessian 流传输，这正是支配中心稳定 Ornstein–Uhlenbeck 极限的同一测度；我们证明了在容差收缩至中心尺度之上时该测度的相对精度，且允许状态依赖噪声和不断增长的观测时域。对于每一个可用的梯度矩 $p>1$，容许窗口均非空。主要技术步骤是中心波动尺度处的矩界以及对非线性误差的低阶矩控制。该结果给出了显式的投影尾部与超额目标尾部、极端分位数，以及一个因子 $b^{1-t}$。
tldr: 该论文为无限方差梯度噪声下的非线性恒定步长 SGD 最后一次迭代建立了精确的一阶尾部概率律，证明其尾部由单个大梯度冲击经局部 Hessian 流传输所主导，并由此给出显式的投影与超额目标尾部及极端分位数。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes exact first-order tail laws for the last iterate of nonlinear constant-stepsize SGD with infinite-variance gradient noise, showing the tails are governed by a single large gradient shock transported through the local Hessian flow, yielding explicit projection and excess-objective tails and extreme quantiles.
